answer.reason: Several battles were fought in the Valley of Salt, and two of them are the chief events told of it.

clauses.english: was where David won a name by striking down eighteen thousand Syrians
clauses.quote: smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men

clauses.english: was where Amaziah's army struck down ten thousand of Edom
clauses.quote: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand

doubts: 1CH 18:12 (Abishai, eighteen thousand Edomites) and PSA 60:1 (Joab, twelve thousand of Edom) tell of further victories there; left out as the same battles are given with different numbers and names, so the line keeps to two clear events.
2KI 14:7 does not name Amaziah; he is named in the next verse and in 2CH 25:11.
